discussion_comments.comment_body: fixed in [`58001639`](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15043/commits/5800163933): [`getClineUris`](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15043/changes#diff-079b91a4102574b1d2271464cfc191c90c21970e9d8572a49a6595c7dd6373baR28) builds credits links under `/dashboard/account` and `/dashboard/organization`, matching desktop and the CLI. the dashboard's `next.config.ts` also redirects `/account` and `/organization` there, so the earlier links landed on the same page one redirect later. this changes the Account view's Add Credits URL too, same destination.

Fixed in 229051e. The restored height is clamped against window.innerHeight on load, and the panel has max-h-[80%] of the pane so a window shrink can never push the chat to zero; the ResizeObserver refits xterm when that cap kicks in.
